exit_rule: 500 notification-accepted raw pairs before the deadline; any loss or uncertainty aborts; no signal-quality-based early exit
rationale: A small, bounded initial opportunity for active-sensor stabilization; provisional engineering parameter, not a demonstrated physical settling time and not inferred from the 5-25 s crop.
phase_index_semantics: zero-based per packet type; concatenated acquisition ordinal = warmup index or 500 + measurement index
phase_transition: only after warmup notification acceptance; no sensor register write, shutdown, FIFO/software-queue clear, session change or loss reset
final_coverage: single cumulative integrity epoch reset before wake through shutdown and final hardware-overflow poll; warmup and measurement emitted counts plus transition and closure construction timestamps
